metadata.keywords: Cyberpunk anime, Cowboy Bebop meets Akira, neon-drenched space noir
metadata.style: Late-90s/early-2000s cyberpunk anime aesthetic — the visual intersection of Cowboy Bebop, Akira, Ghost in the Shell, and Macross Plus. Cel-shaded rendering with visible ink outlines of varying weight: heavy black contours on foreground elements, thinner lines receding into depth. Color theory driven by neon-against-dark contrast — deep indigo and charcoal backgrounds punctuated by hot neon signage, engine glow, and holographic UI elements. Lighting is cinematic and motivated: rim lights pick out edges in cyan or magenta, volumetric haze from exhaust and atmosphere catches colored light, lens flares are stylized anime starbursts rather than photographic.
metadata.quality: Prestige anime film key frame, 2K cinematic cel-shaded illustration
